independent_findings: One complete family is conditional facility-event opportunity leading to direct paid asexual duplication and two actor-owned throttles; five primary classes and native helpers are not separate mechanisms. Allay factory is concrete CREATURE registration; no natural population or cap acceptance.

RecordItem.useOn checks jukebox/HAS_RECORD false; server setFirstItem(copy) calls setItem, whose MUSIC_DISCS tag and level guard control storage/start. Caller then shrinks1 even when no suitable BE/storage; PLAY_RECORD stat request only if player nonnull. Starting record changes clocks/flag, neighbor/event1010/dirty; first JUKEBOX_PLAY is delivered through later eligible tick branch, not startPlaying itself. Loaded disc tag membership not established.

Jukebox block exposes ticker only with HAS_RECORD via createTickerHelper call; helper body is unexpanded. Tick increments ticksSinceLastEvent before testing playing/nonempty/RecordItem, stops at tickCount>=start+length+20 before pulse branch, otherwise at accumulated>=20 resets counter and emits JUKEBOX_PLAY. tickCount advances after branch. Counter accrued while not-playing if ticked, never reset on start; no fixed initial20-tick delay or walltime guarantee. Vanilla constructor converts seconds*20; Forge supplier overload already takes ticks.

Stop changes isPlaying=false before STOP event; removeItem clears slot before stop for old nonempty item. PopOutRecord requests removed stack copy ItemEntity and unchecked add on server, not new offspring/player pickup. Jukebox paired long-clock save/read is an already credited migration owner.

Blockpos events become block center; Forge can suppress event before dispatcher. Dispatcher scans currently available chunks/section registries; Euclidean registration filters by eye-position distance<=100. No LOS predicate here. Dynamic listener only touches existing FULL chunks, and lastSection is updated even if new chunk registry unavailable; no unconditional eventual registration/delivery claim. Tracking add/end/section change request listener updates, not guaranteed music activation.

Jukebox listener uses eye-offset EntityPositionSource from vibration user but is a separate immediate game-event route with radius10; it is not the16-radius note-block vibration service. PLAY stores new position only when not already dancing; STOP clears only matching remembered position or null. Handler returns true independently of setter success. setDancing both directions requires server effectiveAI and !NoAi; starting additionally requires !panicking.

CORRECTION TO PROPOSAL observation6: aiStep condition evaluates isDancing && shouldStopDancing() BEFORE tickCount%20==0. Therefore shouldStopDancing is evaluated on every dancing aiStep reaching this condition, and only false-set/null-clear application is gated by tickCount multiple20. It does not only inspect the environment every20ticks. Predicate uses base position strict distance<100 and JUKEBOX block identity, not BE playing state; eye inclusive listener radius differs. False setter can be refused by NoAi while jukeboxPos still clears when branch runs; no proven stuck-dance gameplay.

DUPLICATION_ITEM directly constructs Ingredient.of(AMETHYST_SHARD), item identity test rather than missing duplication tag. Own mobInteract requires dancing/item/canDuplicate boolean, not mate/liked-player/baby/direct cooldownlong gate. Actual ordinary server C2S branch validates target/worldborder/reach/item enabled, then Player spectator/Forge cancellation and Mob alive/leash/important interactions precede subclass. Generic PLAYER_INTERACTED_WITH_ENTITY criterion and SUCCESS do not prove birth. Complete packet threading/replay/prediction/external hooks unexpanded.

Source order duplicateAllay()->event18/chime request->noncreative shrink1->SUCCESS. Helper returns void with nullable create. On nonnull create it moves to parent, persistenceRequired, child reset6000/false, parent reset6000/false, then ignores addFreshEntity return. Normal create-null returns without either reset yet caller feedback/payment/SUCCESS still happen; add rejection happens after both cooldown resets. No exception rollback or refund guarantee; no direct own side guard inside helper/mobInteract, actual server path studied only.

ServerLevel add rejects removed entity; manager posts cancelable EntityJoinLevelEvent then rejects known UUID, otherwise admits and starts tracking/ticking as visibility permits. SetPersistenceRequired only sets field; no immunity or successful offspring. No explicit placement/obstruction/finalize/mating/NaturalSpawner cap checks in the studied duplication path; this is not universal cross-mod/cap bypass.

Positive long+true flag is not normalized by this method; negative never decremented here. Count means actual delivered updates, not6000 guaranteed elapsedworldticks. Full superclass tick/NoAi scheduling not audited.
